doc_name: IEEE Computer Society Charles Babbage Award
text: In 1989, the International Parallel and Distributed Processing Symposium created the Charles Babbage Award [1] to honor a conference participant annually for exceptional contributions to the field. In nearly all instances, the award is bestowed upon one of the invited keynote speakers at the event. The selection is made by the steering committee chairs, based on recommendations from the Program Chair and General Chair, who oversee the conference's technical program, including the process of inviting speakers. The award is presented right after the selected speaker's presentation at the conference, and the recipient receives a plaque that details the specific contribution recognized by IPDPS.[2] In 2019, the administration of the IEEE CS Babbage Award was transferred to the IEEE Computer Society's Awards Committee.[3] Past recipients:[4]
